title: A mutual friend, E, saw a rectangular craft

tellings.quote: we both have a mutual friend. I I'll call her E. Um, and uh, she's the only person I know who's ever seen a rectangular craft, by the way, which is super interesting.

plain: A woman known only as E once saw a craft shaped like a rectangle, according to the researcher Deep Prasad, who says she is a friend he shares with Michels. Prasad passes on what she told him and keeps her name private. He finds it striking because she is the only person he knows who has seen that shape.
